name: Bilgeri Camping
beschreibung: Bilgeri Camping is a campsite in Tirol. The exact location is not specified, but the accommodation is aimed at holidaymakers with a motorhome or tent. The site offers pitches with electricity and water connections. Sanitary facilities are available on the grounds. The surroundings in Tirol allow for activities such as hiking and cycling. Facilities such as a bread roll service can make the stay easier. The campsite is open seasonally.
